capability_mapping.generic_hash: hkdf-expand-with; opaque validated block/output shape plus explicit one-shot Result callback under its full effect row

records.salt: No salt argument; supplied pseudorandom key used directly
records.context: Raw Bytes preserve every string octet; separate text wrappers explicitly encodeUTF8
records.length: Nat accepts exactly nonnegative requests; enforce requested<=255*outputWidth before MAC work; buffer representability errors are explicit
records.error_mapping: Typed Result preserves caller hash/policy errors; width mismatch and buffer failures are named. SDK FIPS-only errors map to an explicitly selected caller policy, never ambient environment lookup.
records.negative_sdk_lengths: SDK panics are captured by the oracle; primary Nat API makes negative lengths unrepresentable
records.qualification: Static candidate only; no parser/type/runtime/SDK execution claim

generic_contract: Fixed-width mathematical hash/HMAC bytes with all declared callback effects, explicit caller errors and checked widths. Hash object identity, constructor/write/reset invocation counts and ambient service-indicator state are not copied into a different language object model.

no_arbitrary_algorithm_bans.only_descriptor_refusals: Widths outside the byte-buffer length domain; output requests outside protocol/buffer bounds; actual callback width mismatches

ownership: Snapshot original secret/salt/context before any caller callback
Caller policy gets its own copy and runs before output length validation
Prepared generic pads are private and reused without exposure to digest callbacks
Each digest/HMAC input is a fresh owned message; direct HMAC keys are copied per invocation
Validate and snapshot returned callback bytes before reuse, including aliasing/reused callback outputs
One final mutable output buffer, immutable copied previous digest, bounded tail-recursive expansion
No partial key is exposed on any typed error
simd: Eight packed bytes share pure value-only LLVM XOR operations; checked Data.Bytes.Word reads/writes prove each full window and scalar tails handle fringes. No memory-writing pure LLVM primitive is introduced. Bulk concatenation/prefix/output copies use the checked existing memmove operation.
input_nil_mapping: Only absent salt is semantically distinct from supplied empty for unrestricted metadata. Nil/empty IKM, PRK and info are equal byte sequences; successful nil/empty output slices map to Ok empty Bytes, errors to Err.
policy_precedence: Extract validates original IKM; Expand original PRK; combined Key original IKM once, before length errors, without a second derived-PRK policy check.
